Example PCAtools pca object (airway RNA-seq)

Source: R/data.R
example_pca.Rd

A principal component analysis of the airway RNA-seq experiment, in the form PCAtools::pca() returns, used by the PCAtools modules (pcaBiplotServer(), pcaScreePlotServer(), pcaLoadingsPlotServer(), pcaPairsPlotServer() and pcaEigencorPlotServer()). Eight samples (four airway smooth muscle cell lines, each untreated or treated with dexamethasone); the PCA is on the variance-stabilised counts of the 500 most variable genes. The object is a plain list, so it loads without PCAtools installed.

Usage

data(example_pca)

Format

A pca object (a list) with elements:

rotated

Sample scores: a data frame of 8 samples by 8 components

loadings

Gene loadings: a data frame of 500 genes (named by symbol) by 8 components

variance

Percentage of variance explained by each component

sdev

Component standard deviations

metadata

Sample metadata: dex (treatment), cell (cell line), avgLength (mean read length), lib.size (total counts) and size.factor (DESeq2 size factor)

xvars, yvars, components

Sample names, gene names and component names

Source

Generated by data-raw/generate_example_pca.R from the airway Bioconductor data package (Himes et al., 2014, PLoS One 9:e99625).

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

data(example_pca)
round(example_pca$variance, 1)
#>  PC1  PC2  PC3  PC4  PC5  PC6  PC7  PC8 
#> 40.8 26.2 16.9 12.9  1.6  1.0  0.5  0.0 
head(example_pca$metadata)
#>              dex    cell avgLength lib.size size.factor
#> SRR1039508 untrt  N61311       126 20637971   1.0236476
#> SRR1039509   trt  N61311       126 18809481   0.8961667
#> SRR1039512 untrt N052611       126 25348649   1.1794861
#> SRR1039513   trt N052611        87 15163415   0.6700538
#> SRR1039516 untrt N080611       120 24448408   1.1776714
#> SRR1039517   trt N080611       126 30818215   1.3990365
